sample.rule: same temporally safe March-IFBFat subset used for readiness/channel audits: migration start strictly after March 31
sample.rationale: guarantees March IFBFat precedes migration start

directional_prediction.assumption: higher March IFBFat is treated only as a readiness proxy because it predicts earlier migration start in the frozen readiness analysis

decision_rule.strong_proxy_support: both interaction coefficients have predicted sign and 95% animal-cluster bootstrap intervals exclude zero
decision_rule.mixed_proxy_support: exactly one interaction passes predicted-sign interval criterion
decision_rule.H2_status: never promoted to established H2 from this observational proxy test alone

sensitivities: within-year centered predictors and response, interaction formed from within-year centered phase and IFBFat
boundaries: IFBFat is a physiological/nutritional readiness proxy, not a molecular clock and not a direct measurement of G
interaction moderation is observational and may reflect energetic capacity or other state dependence rather than a readiness gate
all downstream actuator observations occur after migration onset
frozen GEB V2 and preregistered outcomes remain unchanged
